stemEn: A 6-year-old has nighttime irritability and mild perianal erythema. A microscopy image of the suspected organism is referenced. Which symptom is most typical?
explanationAr: المصدر يربط الحالة بـEnterobius vermicularis، وأشهر عرض هو nocturnal perianal pruritus بسبب خروج الأنثى ليلًا لوضع البيوض حول الشرج.
reasoningEn: Nighttime perianal itching is the classic symptom emphasized by the source for pinworm infection.
incorrectOptionsAr: Iron deficiency anemia ترتبط أكثر بـhookworm، وmucous diarrhea أو hepatosplenomegaly لا تمثل النمط الكلاسيكي للـEnterobius.
clinicalPearl: Pinworm symptoms are characteristically worse at night.

stemEn: A child has nocturnal perianal itching and the family has seen small white worms near the anus. Which diagnostic test is preferred in the source?
explanationAr: الـpinworm eggs تُوضع حول الشرج، لذلك المصدر يختار perianal tape test وليس stool O&P.
reasoningEn: The perianal tape test samples eggs deposited around the anus and is the diagnostic method selected by the source.
incorrectOptionsAr: Stool O&P أقل فائدة في Enterobius، وstool/rectal bacterial cultures لا تشخص helminth infection.
clinicalPearl: Collect the tape specimen before bathing or toileting when possible.

stemEn: Which statement is selected by the source as true regarding childhood nocturnal enuresis?

options.text: It is more common in girls
Secondary enuresis is more common than primary enuresis

explanationAr: المصدر يختار وجود family history بحوالي 50%، لكنه في الـpearl يذكر رقمًا مختلفًا (44%). الفكرة الصحيحة في المصدر هي وجود strong genetic/familial component، أما الرقم الدقيق فيحتاج verification.
reasoningEn: The source emphasizes familial clustering but is internally inconsistent about the exact percentage.
incorrectOptionsAr: Enuresis أكثر شيوعًا في boys، وprimary monosymptomatic enuresis هو الأكثر شيوعًا، وليس كل طفل يحتاج علاجًا.
clinicalPearl: A strong family history is common in primary nocturnal enuresis, but exact percentages vary by study.

stemEn: A 6-year-old has fatigable bilateral ptosis and extraocular weakness that worsen late in the day. Which initial treatment is selected by the recall source?
explanationAr: العلامات توحي بـjuvenile myasthenia gravis. المصدر يختار neostigmine، لكن current chronic symptomatic therapy غالبًا تُناقش باستخدام pyridostigmine؛ لذلك نُبقي المفتاح recalled ونصنفه conflicting حتى verification.
reasoningEn: The phenotype is consistent with juvenile MG, but the exact cholinesterase-inhibitor choice in the source requires modern verification.
incorrectOptionsAr: IVIG وplasmapheresis تُستخدمان أكثر في exacerbation/crisis أو حالات مختارة، وsteroids قد تدخل في immunotherapy وليست دائمًا أول symptomatic step.
clinicalPearl: Fatigable ocular weakness that worsens with use is a classic clue for myasthenia gravis.

stemEn: A stable 29-week preterm infant has grade-related IVH with mild ventricular dilatation on day-3 cranial ultrasound and no signs of raised intracranial pressure. Which follow-up imaging step is selected by the source?

options.text: Repeat cranial ultrasound after 1 to 2 weeks

explanationAr: المصدر يختار serial cranial ultrasound لأن ultrasound هو وسيلة المتابعة المعتادة للـIVH في preterm infants ويجنب radiation والنقل غير الضروري.
reasoningEn: Serial cranial ultrasonography is the source-selected follow-up modality for a stable preterm infant with IVH.
incorrectOptionsAr: CT ليس routine follow-up، LP ليس imaging test، وEEG يقيّم seizures وليس ventricular evolution.
clinicalPearl: Serial cranial ultrasound is central to monitoring IVH and posthemorrhagic ventricular dilatation in preterm infants.
diagnosticSteps: Repeat cranial ultrasound per neonatal protocol

stemEn: A preterm infant with short bowel syndrome on partial parenteral nutrition has wasting, dry flaky skin, poor wound healing, and thrombocytopenia. Which deficiency is selected by the source?
explanationAr: Dermatitis-like dry skin مع poor wound healing وthrombocytopenia في طفل يعتمد على parenteral nutrition يوجه في المصدر إلى essential fatty acid deficiency.
reasoningEn: The source links the dermatologic and hematologic findings in a lipid-deficient nutrition context to essential fatty acid deficiency.
incorrectOptionsAr: Vitamin E deficiency يسبب neurologic/hemolytic findings أكثر، calorie deficiency وحده لا يفسر النمط، وamino acid deficiency لا يعطي هذه الصورة المميزة.
clinicalPearl: Preterm infants can develop EFAD quickly if adequate lipid is not provided.

stemEn: A 9-month-old recovers from gastroenteritis but develops watery diarrhea, flatulence, and abdominal distension when formula is restarted. What is the most likely cause?
explanationAr: بعد gastroenteritis قد يحدث transient brush-border lactase deficiency، فيظهر osmotic watery diarrhea مع gas/distension عند إعادة lactose-containing feeds.
reasoningEn: The temporal relationship to gastroenteritis and recurrence with milk feeding supports secondary lactose intolerance in the source.
incorrectOptionsAr: Celiac disease عادةً chronic ومع gluten exposure، bacterial enteritis يميل إلى fever/bloody stool، وcow's milk protein allergy لها نمط مختلف وقد تشمل blood/mucus أو allergic features.
clinicalPearl: Secondary lactose intolerance after infectious gastroenteritis is usually temporary.

stemEn: A 7-year-old develops progressive right hemiplegia with left facial weakness and left abducens palsy over two weeks. What diagnosis is selected by the source?

options.text: Left rapidly growing supratentorial brain tumor

explanationAr: وجود ipsilateral cranial nerve deficits مع contralateral hemiplegia يعطي crossed brainstem signs، ولذلك المصدر يختار brainstem glioma.
reasoningEn: Progressive crossed cranial-nerve and long-tract signs localize the lesion to the brainstem.
incorrectOptionsAr: AVM hemorrhage غالبًا acute، supratentorial lesion لا يفسر crossed signs، وcerebellar tumors تميل إلى ataxia/dysmetria أكثر.
clinicalPearl: Crossed cranial-nerve and motor findings are a high-yield brainstem localization clue.

stemEn: A 14-year-old with short stature, no menarche, Tanner stage 1 development, and markedly elevated FSH and LH is evaluated. Which next test is selected by the source?
explanationAr: Short stature مع primary amenorrhea وhypergonadotropic hypogonadism يرفع الشك في Turner syndrome، ولذلك المصدر يختار karyotyping للتأكيد الجيني.
reasoningEn: Elevated gonadotropins indicate primary gonadal failure, and the combination with short stature supports chromosomal evaluation for Turner syndrome.
incorrectOptionsAr: Pelvic ultrasound قد يصف الرحم/المبايض لكنه لا يؤكد الكروموسومات، pituitary MRI يناسب central causes أكثر، وprolactin/bone age لا يحسمان Turner syndrome.
clinicalPearl: Hypergonadotropic hypogonadism plus short stature should trigger consideration of Turner syndrome.

stemEn: A clinically stable 35-week infant has recurrent brief apnea with pallor and desaturation that resolves with stimulation. Which initial management is selected by the recall source?

options.text: Perform a full sepsis workup and start empiric antibiotics
Give 30% supplemental oxygen by nasal cannula

explanationAr: المصدر يعتبر apnea في late-preterm infant علامة تستدعي sepsis evaluation ويختار full workup + empiric antibiotics. لكن current early-onset sepsis management أصبح أكثر risk-based، لذلك لا نعتمد هذا التعميم قبل verification.
reasoningEn: The source prioritizes infection exclusion, but the breadth of sepsis evaluation and empiric treatment depends on current risk-based neonatal protocols.
incorrectOptionsAr: Caffeine قد يناسب apnea of prematurity بعد استبعاد الأسباب الأخرى، oxygen لا يعالج السبب، وintubation ليست الخطوة الأولى إذا كانت النوبات قصيرة وتستجيب للتحفيز.
clinicalPearl: New apnea in a late-preterm infant should prompt evaluation for secondary causes, including infection, before labeling it apnea of prematurity.

stemEn: A newborn has immediate respiratory distress, a scaphoid abdomen, and absent breath sounds on the left. What immediate action is selected by the source?
explanationAr: الـscaphoid abdomen مع unilateral absent breath sounds يوحي بـCDH. المصدر يختار endotracheal intubation ويتجنب bag-mask ventilation حتى لا يزيد دخول الهواء إلى bowel داخل الصدر.
reasoningEn: Suspected CDH requires controlled airway ventilation rather than bag-mask ventilation, which can worsen bowel distension and lung compression.
incorrectOptionsAr: Bag-mask ventilation قد تزيد gastric/bowel distension، ECMO ليست first step، والإصلاح الجراحي يأتي بعد stabilization.
clinicalPearl: In suspected congenital diaphragmatic hernia, avoid bag-mask ventilation and decompress the stomach.

stemEn: A 2-month-old has a left-sided neck swelling that becomes more prominent when the head turns to the right. The infant is otherwise well. Which diagnosis is selected by the source?
explanationAr: ظهور mass على مسار sternocleidomastoid وتغير بروزه مع وضعية الرقبة يوجه في المصدر إلى congenital muscular torticollis / SCM pseudotumor.
reasoningEn: The position-dependent prominence of a lateral SCM-region mass is used by the source to support congenital muscular torticollis.
incorrectOptionsAr: Thyroglossal cyst غالبًا midline ويتحرك مع swallowing/tongue protrusion، lymphatic malformation تكون soft/transilluminant، وbranchial cyst لا تتغير عادةً بهذه الطريقة مع neck motion.
clinicalPearl: Congenital muscular torticollis may present with a sternocleidomastoid mass in early infancy.

stemEn: A 3-week-old has persistent tearing and mild unilateral eye redness from birth, with an abnormal eye finding shown in the source image. What is the next step selected by the source?
explanationAr: المصدر يشتبه congenital glaucoma ويختار urgent ophthalmology referral لأن التأخير قد يسبب irreversible visual damage. الصورة الأصلية لازمة لإثبات finding مثل corneal haze/buphthalmos.
reasoningEn: Congenital glaucoma is vision-threatening and requires urgent specialist assessment; the original image remains a publication gate.
incorrectOptionsAr: Antibiotics تناسب bacterial conjunctivitis، nasolacrimal massage يناسب duct obstruction، وroutine referral بطيئة إذا كان glaucoma suspected.
clinicalPearl: Epiphora, photophobia, and blepharospasm are classic clues for congenital glaucoma.

stemEn: A 4-month-old has chronic diarrhea from early infancy, poor weight gain, and progressive neurologic clumsiness. A peripheral smear is referenced. Which diagnosis is selected by the source?
explanationAr: المصدر يختار abetalipoproteinemia بسبب fat malabsorption مع neurologic manifestations، لكن النص يذكر بصورة متعارضة أن smear يظهر burr cells ثم يناقش acanthocytes. الصورة الأصلية غير مربوطة، لذلك السؤال conflicting + image gate.
reasoningEn: The clinical syndrome supports abetalipoproteinemia, but the source's smear terminology is internally inconsistent and needs image-based review.
incorrectOptionsAr: CCLD يرتبط بـchloride loss/metabolic alkalosis، isolated vitamin E deficiency لا يفسر كامل malabsorption syndrome، وimmunodeficiency لا يفسر characteristic red-cell morphology المقصودة.
clinicalPearl: Abetalipoproteinemia classically causes fat malabsorption, very low ApoB-containing lipoproteins, fat-soluble vitamin deficiency, and acanthocytosis.
diagnosticSteps: Check ApoB/lipid profile if clinically evaluating

stemEn: A 10-month-old has persistent tachypnea, wheeze, hypoxemia, crackles, and hyperinflation six weeks after severe bronchiolitis. Which test is selected by the source to assess suspected postinfectious bronchiolitis obliterans?
explanationAr: استمرار fixed obstructive respiratory symptoms بعد severe viral bronchiolitis يرفع الشك في postinfectious bronchiolitis obliterans، والمصدر يختار chest CT كأفضل imaging assessment.
reasoningEn: CT is the source-selected imaging study for the characteristic small-airway changes of postinfectious bronchiolitis obliterans.
incorrectOptionsAr: Lung biopsy invasive وليست first-line، chest X-ray أقل حساسية، وV/Q scan ليست الاختبار التشخيصي المعتاد لهذه الحالة.
clinicalPearl: Persistent fixed obstruction and hypoxemia after severe lower respiratory infection should raise concern for postinfectious bronchiolitis obliterans.
